name: fxf_tent_keeper
doc: Stands in for saves/field_re/tent_keeper_lake.state: the ROM's own loader (--teleport 5 41 31 0, method jmp) from the upper plaza with Marle following (marle_joins) puts Crono and Marle on the fair's tile (41,31) facing up, below the Tent of Horrors' keeper -- the reference's position, its stacked party and its $0105 = B7 (it came from the plaza the same way).
